Dysfunction of this complex leads to pleiotropic effects, resulting in the distinct but overlapping phenotypic features of both diseases, including neurological, skeletal, and sensory deficits.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in HARS2 or IARS2 in individuals diagnosed with the other disease would falsify this hypothesis. **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of the aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase complex in these distinct rare diseases could reveal common therapeutic targets.
